chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi, from Abu Basir. He said: Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said:

The foundations of disbelief are three: greed, arrogance, and envy. As for greed, when Adam (peace be upon him) was forbidden from the tree, greed drove him to eat from it. As for arrogance, Iblis, when he was commanded to prostrate to Adam, was arrogant. As for envy, the two sons of Adam — when one of them killed his companion out of envy.

key_terms.أصول الكفر: Usul al-Kufr - the foundations or roots of disbelief; the fundamental spiritual vices that underlie all forms of rejection of God
key_terms.الاستكبار: al-Istikbar - arrogance, self-aggrandizement; considering oneself above others or above God's commands
key_terms.الحرص: al-Hirs - greed, covetousness; the insatiable desire for what one does not have
key_terms.الحسد: al-Hasad - envy; wishing for the removal of blessings from others

ai.seo_question: What are the three foundations of disbelief according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq identifies three root causes of disbelief (kufr): greed, arrogance, and envy, each illustrated with a primordial example from sacred history. Adam's greed led him to eat from the forbidden tree, Iblis's arrogance made him refuse to prostrate before Adam, and Cain's envy drove him to murder his brother Abel. These three vices are thus presented as the foundational spiritual diseases from which all forms of disbelief originate.
